description: This file defines the ImportFileSplitter class responsible for splitting large CSV or delimited files into smaller parts, handling header rows, and managing file streams for data import processes within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: ImportFileSplitter
classes.description: A class for splitting a large source file into several smaller files based on a record threshold, with options to handle headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the source file and record threshold, sanitizing inputs.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if the source file exists and is readable.

methods.name: splitSourceFile
methods.description: Splits the source file into multiple smaller files based on the record threshold, with options to handle header rows.

methods.name: getRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of records in the source file after splitting.

methods.name: getFileCount
methods.description: Returns the number of split files created.

methods.name: getSplitFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of a specific split file based on the given file number.
